description:
Retrieves metadata and status of a specific DAG in a Managed Airflow environment.

Use this tool when you need to check if a DAG exists, inspect its metadata (such as schedule
or current state), or verify whether a newly uploaded/updated DAG file has been imported by
Airflow (see `list_import_errors` tool description for more details). In particular, if a
DAG was recently uploaded but `get_dag` returns NOT_FOUND, use `list_import_errors` to check
if any errors occurred during the import.

environment.description: Required. The name of the environment. Format: `projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}`

name: get_dag

catchup.description: Whether the catchup is enabled for the DAG.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The state of the Cachup is unknown.

cronSchedule.description: The DAG's schedule in cron format. Only one of this field or durationSchedule should be set.

dagrunTimeout.description: Maximum runtime of a DAG run before termination with a timeout.

docMd.description: Describes the DAG in Markdown format.

durationSchedule.description: The DAG's schedule as a time duration between runs. Only one of this field or cronSchedule should be set.

endDate.description: The end_date parameter of the DAG (if set).

failStop.description: Whether a "fail_stop" mode is enabled for the DAG.

fileloc.description: File location relative to the Cloud Storage bucket root folder.

lastRunEndTime.description: The end timestamp of the last completed DAG run.

lastUpdated.description: The last time the DAG has been serialized.

maxActiveRuns.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active runs of the DAG. Default is zero.

maxActiveTasks.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active tasks of the DAG. Default is zero.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the DAG, in the form: "projects/{projectId}/locations/{locationId}/environments/{environmentId}/dags/{dagId}".

runningCount.description: The number of running instances of the DAG.

startDate.description: The start_date parameter of the DAG.

state.description: Output only. The current state of the DAG.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The state of the DAG is unknown.
The DAG is available for execution.

tags.description: The list of all tags associated with the DAG.
